summary: Tested Child Dashboard + Report improvements (backend + frontend). Backend: all 6 pytest cases pass — GET /api/sessions/in-progress/{child_id} correctly returns {in_progress:false} idle and {in_progress:true, session_id, age_group, started_at, total_questions:20} when active; PDF endpoint returns 403 for a freshly registered free user and 200 (%PDF...) for parent@test.com (3 credits); PDF text now contains 'Strengths', 'Areas for Improvement', 'Personalized Tips', 'Daily Practice Suggestions', 'Weekly Goals', 'Parent Guidance'. Frontend: found & fixed a CRITICAL Child-Dashboard-blocking bug that caused every /dashboard/child/:childId visit to silently redirect back to /dashboard. Root cause: ChildProfile.jsx expected /missions/{child_id} to return an array, but the backend returns {weekly:[], monthly:[], ...} object -> '(ms.data || []).slice is not a function' TypeError -> useEffect catch block navigated to /dashboard. After the fix the full 9-section Child Dashboard renders in the correct order with all data-testids (child-welcome, child-stats + stat-level/xp/coins/streak, section-missions, section-continue-assessment [continue-assessment-btn], section-featured-games [5 gradient cards + play-now-*], section-brain-skills-tests, section-achievements, section-progress-overview, section-daily-reward). Report page validated on both tiers: FREE user sees hero + KPIs + radar + category + strengths + growth + next-assessment + progress-summary + locked-detailed-section + free-tier-banner; NO tips/daily-practice/weekly-goals/parent-guidance/recommended-games/ai-report cards render. PDF button correctly shows 'PDF (Premium only)' and clicking it navigates to /pricing. PREMIUM (parent@test.com) sees all detailed sections (tips-card, daily-practice-card, weekly-goals-card, parent-guidance-card, recommended-games-section with 3 play-recommended-* cards, ai-report-card) + Download PDF works.

ui_bugs.issue: Mission card renders {m.description}, {m.progress}/{m.target} but the /missions/{child_id} endpoint returns objects shaped {key,title,target,current,xp,completed,claimed} (no description; field is 'current' not 'progress'). Result: description shows empty and progress bar shows 0/undefined -> NaN%. Not blocking, but visually incomplete. Suggest mapping current->progress and hiding description or using title-only.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Improve mission cards in ChildProfile.jsx to correctly use backend field names (m.current instead of m.progress, drop m.description) so the Today's Mission section is fully polished.

OPTIONAL: I left a lightweight console.error('ChildProfile load failed:', e) inside the useEffect catch (was previously a naked `catch {}`). This helps diagnose future failures — safe to keep, but you can remove if you prefer silent redirect.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG FIXED: ChildProfile.jsx assumed /api/missions/{child_id} returns an array; backend (engagement_router.py L270-314) returns an object {weekly:[], monthly:[], week_start, month}. Now flattened via `[...(m.weekly||[]), ...(m.monthly||[])].slice(0,3)`. Recommend adding a similar frontend contract test for every API used in Promise.all so a shape drift never silently unmounts a page.

ChildProfile.jsx useEffect originally had `catch {}` (no error binding, no logging) — swallowed errors made the bug invisible. General guideline: never swallow errors silently; at least console.error them.
Duplicate `stat-xp` and `stat-coins` data-testids exist on BOTH Parent Dashboard and Child Dashboard. Not a bug per se, but naming them stat-child-xp / stat-parent-xp would make tests less ambiguous.
server.py + engagement_router.py combined are >1400 LOC — still recommend splitting into smaller routers.
PDF: pypdf-extracted text confirmed all new sections render. Consider adding a page break before AI Insights to keep printable layout consistent when Strengths/Growth are long.

rca of the issue: Every visit to /dashboard/child/:childId immediately redirected to /dashboard. RCA: /api/missions/{child_id} returns {weekly:[], monthly:[], ...} but ChildProfile.jsx line 62 did `(ms.data || []).slice(0,3)` treating it as an array -> TypeError -> useEffect's naked `catch {}` fired navigate('/dashboard'). Fix: flatten `ms.data.weekly + ms.data.monthly` (with Array.isArray fallback) before .slice, and added `catch(e){console.error(...); navigate...}` so future shape drifts are diagnosable.
